AFTER (T2-3) shows ticks SHRINKING in length (dashes getting shorter) while staying densely spaced, and the short ticks near the highlight are visibly SCATTERED at different perpendicular offsets rather than all sitting on one rigid row line -- reads as an even, organic scatter of varying-length marks, not a fan of straight same-length spokes with a hard gap. torus/contour fan peak: BEFORE shows the radial fan transition directly into a flat white highlight plateau via continuous full-length lines. AFTER shows the same transition breaking into shorter, dash-like ticks just before the highlight boundary -- less of a hard single-line-to-white cutoff.
